summary: Cipher Digital Inc. filed an 8-K furnishing illustrative financials of its subsidiary Stingray Compute LLC and announcing the subsidiary's intention to offer $810 million of senior secured notes due 2031 in a private placement under Rule 144A/Regulation S. This is a debt issuance, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or abrupt management change is described. The filing is a routine current report regarding a proposed offering.
